title: Cinema
about: Types of films, like a comedy, a cartoon or a western, and the people in films. How to talk about films you saw at the cinema, on TV or on DVD.

parts.title: Common mistakes
parts.note: Що йде в кіно — What's on at the cinema? Не пропускай at. Ходити в кіно — go to the cinema, з the. По телевізору — on TV, не in TV. Грати роль — play sb (He played the king), без «роль» і без acted. А фантастика — science fiction: fantastic означає «чудовий». Дивись таблицю.

rows: Що йде в кіно сьогодні ввечері?
What's on at the cinema tonight?
Do you often go to the cinema?
Do you often go to cinema?

items.pattern: a western · watch westerns
items.meaning: a film about cowboys in America a long time ago
items.example: My grandad watches an old **western** every Sunday afternoon.
more: In this **western**, a cowboy rides across the desert on a white horse.
I don't like **westerns**. They're all about horses and cowboys.
items.watchOut: Western як назва фільму — іменник: a western, westerns. Western як прикметник означає «західний»: western Ukraine.

items.pattern: a cartoon · watch cartoons · a cartoon about sth
items.meaning: a film with drawings, not real people
items.example: My little cousin watches a **cartoon** about a funny pig every morning.
more: Which **cartoon** did you love when you were small?
We watched a **cartoon** about penguins on the plane.
items.watchOut: Мультфільм — a cartoon (або an animated film). Не плутай з caricature (карикатура) і comic (комікс). Наголос на другому складі: car-TOON.

items.pattern: a horror film · horror films
items.meaning: a film that is very scary, often with ghosts or monsters
items.example: My brother loves **horror films**, but I always close my eyes.
more: I watched half of a **horror film** and then turned it off.
There's a new **horror film** at the cinema, but it's for adults.
items.watchOut: Фільм жахів — a horror film, а не a film of horrors. Horror стоїть перед film, як прикметник.

items.pattern: a comedy · comedies · a comedy about sth
items.meaning: a funny film that makes you laugh
items.example: Let's watch a **comedy** tonight. I had a bad day.
more: This **comedy** is about a family on a camping holiday.
The whole cinema laughed during the **comedy**.
items.watchOut: Наголос на першому складі: COM-e-dy, а не «комЕді». Множина — comedies.

items.pattern: a thriller · an exciting thriller
items.meaning: an exciting film, often about a crime, where you want to know what happens next
items.example: We watched a **thriller** about a stolen painting. It was very exciting.
more: In a good **thriller**, you don't know the answer until the end.
Dad likes **thrillers** with clever detectives.
items.watchOut: Th вимовляється /θ/: кінчик язика між зубами. Не «sriller» і не «triller».

items.pattern: an action film · action films
items.meaning: a film with lots of fast cars, fights and danger
items.example: There's a great car chase at the start of this **action film**.
more: My uncle only watches **action films** with lots of explosions.
Is this **action film** OK for children?
items.watchOut: Бойовик — an action film (з an, бо action починається з голосного звука). Не fighter: це «боєць».

items.pattern: a science fiction film · science fiction (sci-fi)
items.meaning: a film about the future, space, robots or aliens
items.example: In this **science fiction film**, people live on Mars.
more: My sister loves **science fiction**, especially films about robots.
The aliens in that **science fiction film** were green and very friendly.
items.watchOut: Фантастика — science fiction (коротко sci-fi /ˈsaɪ faɪ/). Fantastic — це «чудовий», а fantasy — фентезі, з драконами й чарівниками.

items.pattern: a musical · a film musical
items.meaning: a film or show where people sing and dance a lot
items.example: We sang the songs from the **musical** all the way home.
more: My mum knows every song from her favourite **musical**.
This **musical** has fantastic dancing.
items.watchOut: Musical — також прикметник «музичний»: a musical instrument. Мюзикл — a musical, з артиклем.

items.pattern: a romantic comedy · romantic comedies (romcom)
items.meaning: a funny film about two people who fall in love
items.example: My aunt loves **romantic comedies** with happy endings.
more: This **romantic comedy** is about two neighbours who always argue.
Mum and Dad watched a **romantic comedy** on Saturday night.
items.watchOut: Розмовно кажуть коротко: a romcom.

items.pattern: a (famous / big) film star
items.meaning: a very famous actor or actress in films
items.example: A **film star** came to our town to make a new film.
more: When she was a child, she wanted to be a **film star**.
Lots of people waited outside the cinema to see the **film stars**.
items.watchOut: Британською — film star, американською — movie star. Про чоловіка й жінку однаково.

items.pattern: be in a film · Who's in it?
items.meaning: act in a film
items.example: My favourite singer **was in** a film last year.
more: Who's **in** the new cartoon? I know the voice.
Our neighbour **was in** a film! She walked past the hero in the street.
items.watchOut: Знятися у фільмі — be in a film, з in. Не on a film.

items.pattern: play sb (in a film) · play the hero
items.meaning: be a person or character in a film
items.example: He **played** a pirate in his first film.
more: Who **plays** the mum in this comedy?
I want to **play** a princess in the school show.
items.watchOut: Грати роль когось — play sb: She played the queen. Без слова «роль» і без acted: не acted the queen.

items.pattern: a (film) director · a film by sb
items.meaning: the person who makes a film and tells the actors what to do
items.example: The **director** shouted 'Stop!' and the actors started again.
more: This film is by a young **director** from Ireland.
Who is the **director** of this cartoon?
items.watchOut: Хибний друг: director у кіно — режисер, а не директор. Директор школи — head teacher. A film by sb — фільм цього режисера.

items.pattern: see a film · Have you seen…? · I saw it
items.meaning: watch a film, often at the cinema
items.example: Have you **seen** the new cartoon about the dragon?
more: We **saw** a funny film on the school trip.
I've **seen** this film five times!
items.watchOut: Неправильне дієслово: see — saw — seen. Про кіно кажуть see a film або watch a film; про телевізор і DVD частіше watch.

items.pattern: on TV · watch sth on TV · What's on TV?
items.meaning: shown on television
items.example: I didn't go to the cinema. I saw it **on TV**.
more: There's a great cartoon **on TV** at six.
What's **on TV** tonight?
items.watchOut: По телевізору — on TV, не in TV і не by TV.

items.pattern: I loved it · I enjoyed it · enjoy sth
items.meaning: like something very much
items.example: We went to the musical and I **loved it**!
more: Did you **enjoy** the film?
My dad **enjoyed** the comedy, but my mum didn't.
items.watchOut: Enjoy потребує додатка: I enjoyed it / I enjoyed the film. Просто I enjoyed звучить незакінчено. І «мені сподобалось» — I liked it / I loved it, а не It liked me.

items.pattern: be boring · a boring film
items.meaning: not interesting
items.example: The film was **boring**, so I played with my phone.
more: My brother thinks all musicals are **boring**.
The first half was **boring**, but the end was great.
items.watchOut: Boring — нудний (фільм, урок). Bored — тобі нудно: I was bored. The film was boring, а не The film was bored.

items.pattern: like sth best · Which do you like best?
items.meaning: like it more than all the others
items.example: I like all films, but I like cartoons **best**.
more: Which film did you **like best** this year?
My friends like comedies, but I **like** thrillers **best**.
items.watchOut: Best стоїть у кінці: I like comedies best. Можна і like sth most. Не «I best like».

items.pattern: What's on (at the cinema / on TV)? · There's a… on
items.meaning: what films are showing at the cinema now
items.example: **What's on at the cinema** this weekend?
more: Let's check **what's on** before we go.
There's a new comedy **on at the cinema** this week.
items.watchOut: Що йде в кіно — What's on at the cinema? Не пропускай at: не What's on the cinema.

items.pattern: go to the cinema · go to the cinema with sb
items.meaning: go to a place where you watch films on a big screen
items.example: We **go to the cinema** on the first Saturday of every month.
more: Do you want to **go to the cinema** after school?
I **went to the cinema** with my cousins on my birthday.
items.watchOut: Ходити в кіно — go to the cinema, з the. Без the (go to cinema) — типова помилка. Кінотеатр — cinema, не kino.

items.pattern: watch a DVD · watch films at home
items.meaning: watch a film on a disc at home
items.example: It was cold outside, so we **watched a DVD** at home.
more: On long car trips, my brother **watches DVDs** in the back.
Shall we **watch a DVD** after dinner?
items.watchOut: DVD читається по літерах: /ˌdiː viː ˈdiː/. Дивитися — watch; дехто каже й see a DVD.

items.pattern: a film / comedy with sb (in it)
items.meaning: a film where this actor plays
items.example: I've seen every film **with** that actor. He's so funny.
more: I want to see every film **with** that funny actress.
Is there a cartoon **with** the voice of a famous singer?
items.watchOut: A film with sb — фільм, де грає ця людина. A film by sb — фільм цього режисера.

warmup.uk: Що йде в кіно сьогодні ввечері?
warmup.explain: Що йде в кіно — What's on at the cinema? Прийменник at не пропускаємо.
Ходити в кіно — go to the cinema, з to і the.

warmup.uk: Хто грав короля в цьому фільмі?
warmup.q: Who ___ the king in this film?
warmup.explain: Грати роль — play sb: Who played the king?

warmup.uk: Я бачив цей фільм по телевізору.

warmup.q: We watched a ___ about a bear.
warmup.explain: Мультфільм — a cartoon. Caricature — карикатура, comic — комікс.
Найбільше подобається — like sth best, best стоїть у кінці.
Знятися у фільмі — be in a film.

A.q: We saw a ___ last night. There were cowboys and horses in it.
Films with ghosts that make you scream are ___.
A.explain: Страшні фільми з привидами — horror films.

A.q: I want to watch a film about robots and life in the year 3000. I love ___.
A.explain: Фільми про роботів і майбутнє — science fiction.

B.q: Is she a ___? I think I saw her in a big Hollywood film.
B.explain: Відома акторка, яку бачать у фільмах, — film star. Director — режисер, його на екрані зазвичай не видно.

B.q: Who ___ the father in the film? He was very funny.
B.explain: Грати роль — play sb, у минулому часі played.

B.q: Our teacher was ___ a film when she was young!
B.explain: Знятися у фільмі — be in a film.

C.q: On Saturday I went ___ cinema with my friends.
C.explain: Go to the cinema — з to і the.

C.q: Grandad doesn't go to the cinema. He watches films ___.
Grandma wanted to go home in the middle. She thought the film was ___.
C.explain: Про фільм кажуть boring (нудний). Bored — коли нудно людині.

example.title: The little robot
example.uk:
Минулої п'ятниці Оля з братом хотіли піти в кіно. Вони подивилися в інтернеті, що йде в кінотеатрі. Там був фільм жахів, але Оля сказала: «Ні! Після страшних фільмів я не можу заснути».

Тож вони вибрали мультфільм про маленького робота. Робота грала відома кінозірка. Пісні були чудові, і фільм був зовсім не нудний.

Олі мультфільм дуже сподобався. А братові найбільше сподобався смішний пес. Удома вони подивилися на диску ще один фільм про робота.
example.en:
Last Friday, Olya and her brother wanted to [[go to the cinema|c7]]. They looked online to see [[what was on at the cinema|c6]]. There was a [[horror film|a3]], but Olya said, 'No! I can't sleep after scary films.'

So they chose a [[cartoon|a2]] about a little robot. A famous [[film star|b1]] [[played|b3]] the robot. The songs were great, and the film wasn't [[boring|c4]] at all.

Olya [[loved it|c3]]. Her brother liked the funny dog [[best|c5]]. At home, they [[watched a DVD|c8]] of another robot film.
